name: MemWeave Cross-Agent Reuse Benchmark
source: Original synthetic examples authored for MemWeave; no user transcripts or third-party benchmark rows are included.
license: CC-BY-4.0 (proposed for this dataset only; attribution and license require maintainer confirmation)
limitations: This is a retrieval and governance diagnostic set, not a full conversational memory benchmark.
The 500 rows are ten controlled scenarios over 50 independent synthetic fact kernels, not 500 independent facts.
It does not by itself measure real-agent task success or prove that agents improve with longer use.
The initial labels and baseline require human review before a formal public release.
